subtitle: A right-hand reef break on black volcanic sand in Guanacaste's Nicoya seismic gap, reached by an unpaved road into the village of Los Pargos.
spike_statement: This reef break sits on the northern edge of the segment that ruptured in the M7.6 Nicoya quake of 5 Sept 2012; whether that reshaped the wave is unverified.

levers.photo_tone: Charcoal-black sand under flat Pacific glare, reef spray backlit at low tide, no push toward postcard-blue color grading
